result.reason: The operative addition exactly implements the stated fallback limits for E&O and cyber/privacy insurance but omits CGL, workers' compensation, certificates, and the higher preferred E&O and cyber limits. It leaves the existing representation-by-counsel provision unchanged and adds no unrelated obligation. Drafting quality is adequate, though the insurance requirement does not expressly state the coverage period or whether the stated limits are per claim or aggregate.
